title: Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   C. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care for widows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Labour Relations in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ethics of Da’wa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. C — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. B — Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care for widows; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Labour Relations in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ethics of Da’wa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
